title: eria eriaeoides
intro: Eria eriaeoides, commonly known as the "Orchid Tree", is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress due to its adaptogenic properties. The therapeutic actions of Eria eriaeoides are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system and promote relaxation. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
